title: Number Details
concept: Static House, a fictional slow-audio podcast network on warm paper, where one quiet two-digit mono marker style (01, 02, 03) sits in the same places throughout: a ruled section gutter, the corners of the show cards, a process timeline rail and beside each episode title.
notes: No dependencies beyond Google Fonts (Bricolage Grotesque + IBM Plex Mono). Show covers are CSS-only patterns. Numbers are aria-hidden decoration over semantic <ol> lists and lift to full ink on hover/playing. Play buttons only toggle a playing state (no audio). Reveal-on-scroll via IntersectionObserver; reduced motion shows everything static and stops the on-air bars.
